correctness.summary: Condition (12) gives a universal lower bound on the size of every admissible two-Hadamard pair via AM--HM. Lemma 20 supplies Hadamard orders asymptotically just above the lower endpoint; for equal orders, conditions (13) and (14) reduce to the same upper-endpoint inequality as condition (12). These bounds match asymptotically, and the Taylor expansion at p=2 yields the coefficient 2/ln 2.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2013 source records the weaker leading constant 4/ln 2 in its proof of Theorem 6. Searches by exact formulas, Proposition 23, Hadamard terminology, and later maximal-equilateral literature found no statement of the factor-two sharpening or the construction-optimality result.

value.summary: The result halves the displayed leading constant in the 2013 Hadamard construction and proves the new constant is asymptotically optimal throughout Proposition 23, including asymmetric Hadamard-order choices.

limitations: The optimality statement applies only to the two-Hadamard construction in Proposition 23, not to m(ell_p^d) globally.
The result is asymptotic as p approaches 2 and does not optimize every fixed-p discrete instance.
Originality remains subject to residual risk from unindexed, inaccessible, or differently phrased literature.
